text: Who else is moving to Irvine this summer?? 😅 We close in August and I'm trying to connect with other people relocating around the same time — would love to compare notes on schools, neighborhoods, and just make some friends before we even get there!
comment_source_reason: Audience-gathering post from someone relocating into Orange County; replies surface other people whose housing is about to change into the area, plus agents and lenders pitching their services — exactly the client's buyer types.
